cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 126, destination Beijing, 8900 meters maintaining, over TMR, TZH10, squawk 6021, now contact Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 126，目的地北京，保持8900米，过TMR，TZH 10，squawk 6021，现在联系北京管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR 126, 8900m maintaining, over TMR, TZH 10, squawk 6021.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，AFR 126，保持8900米，过TMR，TZH 10，squawk 6021。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, Beijing Control, squawk 6021, radar contact, negative short cut, over fly TZH due to Air Force activity.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，北京管制，squawk 6021，雷达联系。因空军活动，不能直飞，需飞越TZH。
cards.referenceText: Radar contact, over fly TZH due to Air Force movement, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷达联系，因空军活动飞越TZH，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: B: Ask the controller which runway is in use.
cards.audioTextZh: 询问管制员当前使用跑道。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR 126, request runway in use.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，AFR 126，请问使用跑道。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, expect KM-01 arrival, runway in use 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，预计KM-01 进场，使用跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Expect KM-01 arrival, Runway 36L, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计KM-01 进场，使用跑道36L，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: B: Ask whether you can use KM-03 arrival and land on Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: 询问是否可以使用KM-03 进场并在01跑道落地。
cards.referenceText: If available, request KM-03 arrival, land on Runway 01, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如可用，申请KM-03 进场，01跑道落地，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, after KM, you can request Beijing Approach for change of runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，过KM后可以向北京进近申请更换跑道。
cards.referenceText: After KM, request change runway, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过KM后申请更换跑道，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, descend to and maintain 4500 meters over KM.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，过KM下降并保持4500米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4500 meters over KM, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过KM下降并保持4500米，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, contact Beijing Approach 119.7, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，联系北京进近119.7，再见。
cards.referenceText: 119.7, good day, AFR 126.

cards.audioText: B: Over KM, maintaining 4500 meters, contact Beijing Approach and request Runway 01, KM-03 arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 过KM，保持4500米，联系北京进近并申请01跑道、KM-03 进场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR 126, over KM, 4500 meters maintaining, request Runway 01 KM-03 arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR 126，过KM，保持4500米，申请01跑道KM-03 进场。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, negative due to spacing, KM-01 arrival, runway in use 36L, information A.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，因间隔原因不能同意。执行KM-01 进场，使用跑道36左，通播A。
cards.referenceText: KM-01 arrival, runway in use 36L, information A, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: KM-01 进场，使用跑道36L，通播A，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller that your flap has some problem.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉管制员你的襟翼有故障。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR 126, we're having trouble with our flaps.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，AFR 126，我们襟翼有故障。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 126, roger, say intention.
B: You have to hold for a check.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，收到，报告意图。你需要等待检查。
cards.referenceText: Request holing for a check, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 申请等待检查，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1012, turn left direct to HUR, hold as published.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，按QNH 1012下降并保持3000米，左转直飞HUR，按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1012, turn left direct to HUR, hold as published, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1012下降并保持3000米，左转直飞HUR，按公布程序等待，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: B: Operations are now normal, request landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 操作已恢复正常，申请落地。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR 126, operations are now normal, request landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR 126，操作已恢复正常，申请落地。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, Beijing Approach, continue holding, runway is being cleaned due thick snow, landing action poor.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，北京进近，继续等待。因大雪，跑道正在清扫，着陆性能差。
cards.referenceText: Holding position, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持等待，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: B: There is something wrong with the nose wheel steering system, request a tug after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 前轮转弯系统故障，申请落地后牵引车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR 126, request a tug after landing, our nose wheel steering system failed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR 126，前轮转弯系统失效，申请落地后牵引车。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, AFR 126, is there anything else abnormal?
B: Other systems normal, ask the controller how long the delay is.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：收到，AFR 126，还有其他异常吗？
其他系统正常，询问管制员延误多久。
cards.referenceText: Negative, other systems normal, how long is the delay? AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，其他系统正常，请问延误多久？AFR 126。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 126, snow is getting heavier, you have to hold about 1 hour.
B: The remaining fuel can hold for half hour, you have to request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，雪越来越大，你们需要等待约1小时。剩余油量只能等待半小时，你必须申请备降。
cards.referenceText: Our endurance is 30 minutes, request diversion, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们续航时间30分钟，申请备降，AFR 126。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 126, stand by.
B: Your fuel temperature indicates
abnormal, you can only hold 10 minutes, request diversion to Dalian airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，请稍等。你的燃油温度指示异常，只能再等待10分钟，申请备降大连机场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR 126, our fuel temperature indicates abnormal, endurance only 10 minutes, request divert to Dalian airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR 126，我们燃油温度指示异常，续航只剩10分钟，申请备降大连机场。

cards.audioText: C: Standby 1, we will ask Air Force to use a temporary route.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：请稍等，我们将向空军申请使用临时航路。
cards.referenceText: Roger, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, climb to and maintain 8100 meters on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，按标准气压爬升并保持8100米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 8100 meters on standard, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升并保持8100米，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, direct to Dalian airport, contact Beijing Control 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，直飞大连机场，联系北京管制120.35。
cards.referenceText: Direct to Dalian airport, 120.35, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞大连机场，120.35，AFR 126。
